title_en: Hydrodynamic description of proliferating active matter
title_zh: 增殖活性物质的流体动力学描述

verified_metadata.title: Hydrodynamic description of proliferating active matter
verified_metadata.abstract: We develop a continuum theory for proliferating active matter starting from a microscopic stochastic model of self-propelled particles undergoing birth, death, and nonlocal competition. Beginning from the master equation, we derive mean-field evolution equations for the particle density and polarization fields and close the resulting hierarchy through a von Mises ansatz, providing a coupled hydrodynamic description applicable to a broad class of proliferating active systems. As an application, we study the recently introduced Active Brownian Bug model, in which the form of flocking emerges despite the absence of explicit alignment interactions. Linear stability analysis predicts both Turing and Hopf instabilities, whose analytical thresholds agree with numerical simulations. The continuum model reproduces the principal dynamical regimes of the underlying particle system, including homogeneous states, stationary periodic clusters, and coherently propagating flocking states. These results establish a general continuum framework for proliferating active matter and provide a physical interpretation of collective motion driven by the interplay between activity and population dynamics.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: Nathan Silvano、Emilio Hernandez-Garcia与Cristóbal López来自IFISC, CSIC-UIB。
官方快照arXiv:2608.03317v1，主分类cond-mat.soft，另含cond-mat.stat-mech；22页、10幅图、7个补充视频。
论文从lattice master equation推导density–polarization continuum theory，并用Active Brownian Bug个体模型作具体应用。

sections.title: 摘要
bullets: 微观粒子带位置与离散朝向，发生birth、death、nonlocal competition、orientation-dependent hopping与tumbling。
mean-field与连续极限生成angular-moment hierarchy；von Mises closure用ρ和P重建所有orientation moments，在强极化时仍保持正且归一。
Active Brownian Bug化简为含nonlocal logistic growth、self-advection、density-gradient forcing和nematic correction的两场PDE。
homogeneous state的linear stability有finite-k Turing与Hopf两类不稳定，分别对应stationary clusters与traveling waves。
非线性数值显示无显式alignment也能形成coherently drifting clustered flock，机制是density gradient产生polarization、polarization反过来advect density。

sections.title: 背景
bullets: 多数active-matter模型固定粒子数，但tissue、bacteria与wound healing中birth/death和resource competition会与motility共同决定patterns。
Vicsek型flocking通常写显式方向对齐；Active Brownian Bug此前展示proliferation加self-propulsion也可出现global motion。
被动Neighborhood-dependent Brownian bug靠有限range competition形成stationary periodic/hexagonal clusters。
本文目标既是给proliferating active particle的一般推导，也是解释ABB中alignment-free flocking从何而来。

sections.title: 模型与方法
bullets: square lattice允许site多重占据；state n_x^θ记录位置x和M个orientation，master equation含WB、WD、WC、WH、WT五类transition rates。
非对称hopping在continuum limit给v0 n̂(θ)·∇，对称部分给D_T∇²；symmetric tumbling给D_R∂_θ²。
birth/competition kernels分为空间S与orientation Φ并假设homogeneous/isotropic；mean-field factorization关闭occupation correlations。
angular Fourier modes ρ_n=∫ρ(x,θ)e^{inθ}dθ中ρ_0=ρ、ρ_1=P_x+iP_y；von Mises ansatz由|P|/ρ=I_1(κ)/I_0(κ)反解κ。
ρ equation精确到closure：∂tρ=D_T∇²ρ−v0∇·P+demography；P equation另含−v0∇ρ/2+v0∇·Q，Q由I_2/I_0和P构造。
ABB取offspring继承parent位置与方向、constant death、top-hat range R内competition；dimensionless controls为Pe=v0R/D_T、D_r=D_RR²/D_T与μ=(b−d)R²/D_T。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: homogeneous nonzero fixed point为ρ=1、p=0；linearization后transverse polarization总稳定，density与longitudinal polarization形成2×2 Jacobian。
Turing条件要求top-hat Fourier transform S̃(k)<0，并满足μS̃(k)<−[k²+Pe²k²/(2(k²+D_r))]；Pe升高把pattern onset推向更大μ。
finite-k Hopf在trace越过0且determinant仍正时发生，threshold μ_c=−(2k_c²+D_r)/S̃(k_c)；Turing–Hopf交点由trace=det=0给出。
quasi-1D Figure 3在D_r=0.7的μ–Pe平面显示homogeneous D、stationary patterned PC与structured flocking SSF，Turing/Hopf解析线与onset区域相符。
patterns先经Turing形成；较大μ和Pe后左右对称polarization非线性破缺，clusters以共同速度漂移，ψ从约0变为接近1。
局部机制由两项闭环：−Pe∇ρ/2在cluster edges生成outward polarization，−Pe∇·p使density advect；nonlocal demographic coupling同步邻近clusters的drift方向。
二维Figures 4–5再现homogeneous、stationary hexagonal asters与traveling aligned hexagonal clusters；μ=350时Pe=1.5为stationary、Pe=3.5为traveling example。
forward/backward parameter sweeps显示bistability与hysteresis，说明Turing和Hopf相关transition具有subcritical nonlinear character。
continuum没有再现particle model的spatially disordered但globally polarized F phase；作者归因于被mean-field丢失的density/demographic fluctuations。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
bullets: 从master equation到deterministic PDE用了mean-field factorization，消除了birth–death shot noise与parent–offspring correlations；缺失F phase正显示这些fluctuations可能关键。
von Mises假设orientation distribution单峰；counter-propagating、nematic、multimodal或defect core附近可能不适用，虽比first-harmonic closure更适合强polarization。
ABB原birth rate是max(0,b−cN_R)，continuum去掉positivity clipping并只选参数使rate不负；高density或扰动区可能越出等价范围。
linear thresholds只判断homogeneous state onset，不预测secondary drift、selected velocity、hysteresis width或fully nonlinear phase boundaries。
论文把continuum phases与既有particle ABB定性对照，没有在同一参数映射下给逐点density structure factor、velocity或critical threshold误差。
2D phase maps在固定L=10、D_r=0.7和有限终止t=10上生成；long-time、system-size与noise robustness未系统展示。
ψ是spatial average of P/ρ，低密度区可能放大数值误差；需与total polarization及center-of-mass velocity交叉检查。
无显式alignment不等于无effective alignment：offspring继承方向、density gradients和nonlocal cluster coupling提供间接polar-order feedback。
biological generality仍是理论框架层面；没有具体tissue/bacteria实验参数拟合或数据验证。

sections.title: 复现与资源
bullets: 先重建lattice rates到Eqs. (47)–(48)的符号推导，逐项检查birth/death/competition normalization、R scaling和Q tensor signs。
数值反演κ=A^{-1}(|p|/ρ)时对ratio做物理区间控制，并在ρ≈0处regularize；验证von Mises normalization与small-κ first-harmonic limit。
用spectral Jacobian直接扫描k，独立求Turing、Hopf和codimension-two point；与PDE早期growth rate逐mode比较。
phase map每点多noise seeds并延长终止时间，保存ψ、〈ρ〉、structure factor、travel speed、winding/defect count和hysteresis direction。
在1D/2D做L与grid convergence，检查top-hat convolution de-aliasing、time-step stability及mass/demographic balance。
与particle ABB做matched dimensionless parameters和system size比较，量化threshold、cluster spacing、ψ、velocity及F-phase缺失。
加入Dean/birth-death multiplicative noises并逐项ablate，检验是否恢复F phase及parent-inheritance correlation机制。

sections.title: 阅读指南
bullets: 先看Figure 1与Eqs. (29)–(32)，理解ρ equation何处精确、P equation何处依赖von Mises closure。
Eqs. (42)–(48)是ABB的最小continuum model，三个dimensionless parameters便于复现。
linear stability Eqs. (53)–(61)区分Turing和Hopf onset；随后Figures 2–5展示nonlinear secondary drift。
结尾特别关注未再现F phase的负结果，它界定deterministic mean-field closure的证据边界。
